note: Recorded identities of the preserved schema-13 executables the upgrade rehearsal may seed with. The rehearsal hashes the executable it is given and refuses anything that does not match this file: a binary of another platform, another revision or the current source is not the release the rehearsal is about. When a hosted Linux baseline is acquired, record its sha256 and embedded build revision under linux-amd64 first — the rehearsal fails loudly for a platform with no entry.
